chunks: Ibn Abi Umeyr, from Hisham ibn Salim, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
It was forty years between the Word of Allah, Mighty and Majestic, 'Your supplication has been accepted,' and the Seizing of the Pharaoh.
ai.seo_question: Why was the supplication of Musa and Harun accepted but delayed for forty years?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies that the phrase 'your supplication has been answered' (Qad Ujibat Dawatukuma) signifies divine acceptance rather than instantaneous execution, highlighting a forty-year interval between the prayer and the Pharaoh's downfall. This distinction is crucial in Shia theology for understanding the wisdom behind delayed responses (Takhir), teaching believers that acceptance is guaranteed even if the manifestation is postponed to a time of optimal divine wisdom.
